notes.title: Arcade LA Deadzone being deprecated from the Steam store for sequel!
notes.notes:
Hi Arcade LA Deadzone fans! 

Castle Steps is excited to be bringing a new LA Deadzone title to the masses, and therefore Arcade LA Deadzone is being deprecated from the Steam Store this coming Monday. 

For more information on the new release, please reach out to
business@castlestepsgames.com

Thank you so much for supporting LA Deadzone!
